title: Keyboard shortcuts
intro: These work wherever their screen is open. Shortcuts with a single key do nothing while you type in a field.

action.drawer: Show or hide the panel (assistant, terminal, events, logs, problems)
action.close: Close the topmost layer: menu, dialog, the panel while focus is in it (not inside a terminal), inspector, then full screen
action.submit: Submit the composer, approve the focused crew, send a message or comment
action.assistant: Open the panel on the task assistant, or stop it and close the panel
action.assistant.send: Send your message to the task assistant (Shift Enter adds a line)
action.graph.menu: Open the menu of the focused node
action.graph.move: Move the focused node by one grid step
action.panel.terminal: Open the panel on the terminal, or hide it
action.panel.problems: Open the panel on problems, or hide it
action.terminal.close: On a terminal's tab: end its shell (asks while it runs)
action.terminal.leave: Inside a terminal: move focus back to its tab (Tab goes to the shell)
